mentions.name: fastsleep.app
mentions.description: This web app helps users get sleepy quickly through short guided sessions (as short as 7 minutes) that require no medicinal pills or long-form meditation. Users close their eyes and visualize brief micro-scenarios they hear, such as "moonlight on a white flower", until the next prompt arrives. It can also be used to break a nightly doomscrolling habit.
mentions.problem: Difficulty falling asleep quickly without relying on medication or long meditation sessions, and breaking a nightly doomscrolling habit.
mentions.audience: People who want to fall asleep quickly, including those trying to break a nightly doomscrolling habit
mentions.source_excerpt:
Recently worked on https://fastsleep.app

Use this to quickly get sleepy without taking any medicinal pill or long form meditation type things (It is as short as 7-minute session).

Easy to use. Simply close your eyes and imagine the micro-scenarios you hear.
mentions.author: greybox555

mentions.name: FastSleep
mentions.description: FastSleep is a sleep-aid app for nighttime overthinkers. Instead of music or long podcasts, it gives users short imaginative audio prompts (e.g., "moonlight on a white flower") to visualize until the next one. Users close their eyes, listen, and imagine each scenario to drift off to sleep.
mentions.problem: Overthinking at night makes it hard to fall asleep, and music or long podcasts don't address it
mentions.audience: Nighttime overthinkers who struggle to fall asleep
mentions.source_excerpt:
Recently worked on https://fastsleep.app - an app for nighttime overthinkers.

Instead of music or long podcasts, you are given something to imagine. Like if you hear "moonlight on a white flower", imagine that scenario until you hear the next one.
mentions.author: greybox555
